findings.recommendation: Replace the backslash segments in validate.ps1:7 and :12 and validate-changed.ps1:8 with Join-Path segments such as `Join-Path $RepoRoot '.context' 'retros'`, then run both gates on ubuntu-latest. Check the retro-full-audit and governance retro-schema run results in CI, which this checkout cannot show.
findings.details: Retro schema gates build paths with backslashes, so they cannot run on the ubuntu-latest runner. validate.ps1:7 default `Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\.."` is evaluated when retro-full-audit.yml:24 runs the script with no -RepoRoot. validate.ps1:12 then joins `.context\retros`; on Linux a backslash is a literal filename character, so the default resolves to null (ErrorActionPreference is set only at :11), and the join at :12 fails. validate-changed.ps1:8 uses the same `'..\..'` with ErrorActionPreference=Stop at :7, so governance.yml:38-40 stops before any diff. Not executed: pwsh is not installed in this sandbox. CI run outcomes are outside this checkout.
